name: sandboxed: no Node in the page, window.srm present
js: return { require: typeof require, process: typeof process, module: typeof module, srm: Object.keys(window.srm || {}), env: window.srm.env }

name: preload refuses other IPC channels
js: try { window.srm.sendSync('steam-owned-games'); return 'NOT refused'; } catch (e) { return 'refused: ' + e.message }

name: titlebar window info (app.windowInfo)
js: const t = ng.getComponent(document.querySelector('titlebar')); return { minimizable: t.minimizable, maximizable: t.maximizable }

name: open Add Games
js: location.hash = '#SRM/preview'; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000)); return location.hash

name: generate
js: const c = ng.getComponent(document.querySelector('preview')); c.generatePreviewData(); const v = c.previewService.getPreviewVariables(); const t = Date.now(); while ((!v.listHasGenerated || v.listIsBeingGenerated || v.numberOfQueriedImages) && Date.now() - t < 90000) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const pd = c.previewService.getPreviewData(); window.__steamDir = Object.keys(pd)[0]; return { items: v.numberOfListItems, steamDir: window.__steamDir, titles: Object.values(Object.values(pd)[0])[0] && Object.values(Object.values(Object.values(pd)[0])[0].apps).map(a => a.title) }

name: View Games lists the saved shortcuts (library.read)
js: location.hash = '#SRM/view'; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const v = ng.getComponent(document.querySelector('view')); const t0 = Date.now(); while ((v.refreshingGames || !v.viewService.shortcuts) && Date.now() - t0 < 30000) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const s = v.viewService.shortcuts; const users = s[window.__steamDir]; return { dirs: Object.keys(s), users: users && Object.keys(users), apps: users && Object.values(users)[0].map(x => x.appname) }

name: shortcut details (library.details)
js: const v = ng.getComponent(document.querySelector('view')); const s = v.viewService.shortcuts[window.__steamDir]; const user = Object.keys(s)[0]; const sc = s[user].find(x => /Super Mario World/.test(x.appname)) || s[user][0]; await v.setCurrentShortcut(window.__steamDir, user, sc); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); return { launch: v.currentLaunch, cats: v.currentCats, enabled: v.currentControllerEnabled, artwork: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(v.currentArtwork).map(([k, u]) => [k, String(u).slice(0, 12) + '...' + String(u).slice(-24)])), imgs: [...document.querySelectorAll('view img.artwork')].map(i => i.complete && i.naturalWidth > 0) }

name: steam logins with avatars (support.steamLogins)
js: const t = ng.getComponent(document.querySelector('titlebar')); return await t.coreClient.client.call('support', 'steamLogins', window.__steamDir)

name: browsed path (support.browsedValue)
js: const t = ng.getComponent(document.querySelector('titlebar')); const c = t.coreClient.client; return [c.callSync('support', 'browsedValue', 'C:\\Games\\SNES [USA]', null, {}), c.callSync('support', 'browsedValue', 'C:\\Games\\SNES [USA]', null, { useForwardSlash: true }), c.callSync('support', 'browsedValue', 'C:\\Games\\SNES [USA]', null, { appendGlob: '${title}.@(sfc|smc)' }), c.callSync('support', 'browsedValue', 'C:\\Games\\SNES', 'D:/old/**/${title}.sfc', { appendGlob: '${title}.@(sfc|smc)' })]

name: remove from Steam
js: location.hash = '#SRM/preview'; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000)); const c = ng.getComponent(document.querySelector('preview')); c.generatePreviewData(); const v = c.previewService.getPreviewVariables(); const t = Date.now(); while ((!v.listHasGenerated || v.listIsBeingGenerated || v.numberOfQueriedImages) && Date.now() - t < 90000) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); await c.remove(); return c.previewService.getPreviewData() === undefined

name: log: errors and shell scripts
js: location.hash = '#SRM/logger'; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); const text = ng.getComponent(document.querySelector('log')).loggerService.logText(); return text.split('\n').filter(l => /^\[error\]|shell scripts/i.test(l)).slice(0, 15)
